effective_outcomes.official_disposition: The original Official bootstrap and the single executed exact-script retry both failed while pip cloned the public qrenderer dependency from GitHub. Both contain repeated TLS truncation evidence and ended before Pyright, so the frozen infrastructure policy censors A without imputing a pass or failure. No further retry is allowed.

paired_result.supported_observation: on this case, same-session clean replay exposed non-transferable local success, missing evaluator-visible dependencies, and a fragile Git transport; B revised the deployment program until the exact replayed artifact passed Official, but consumed substantially more resources than A
paired_result.network_robustness_boundary: B converted a TLS failure observed inside its active replay loop into a robust tarball-based program, while A's post-session TLS failures are censored by the frozen protocol. This is valid mechanism evidence but not a paired pass-rate effect; future studies must preregister whether dependency-acquisition robustness is an algorithmic outcome or infrastructure censoring.
